title: HeritageGraph Ontology
description: HeritageGraph is an event-centric OWL ontology for describing Nepalese living heritage — its tangible objects, sacred places, deities, rituals, festivals, and the communities and institutions (notably the *Guthi*) that sustain them. Rather than attaching facts directly to objects, the model represents history as a web of events (production, ritual, custody transfer, documentation) so that spatial, temporal, and participatory relationships can be queried and reasoned over. Every assertion can carry its provenance and epistemic standing, allowing competing or multi-vocal sources to coexist. The ontology is generated from a LinkML schema, is an OWL 2 DL vocabulary that is logically consistent under the HermiT reasoner, and is aligned with CIDOC-CRM 7.1.3, CRMinf, CRMsci, and PROV-O, and through a companion module with Linked Art, to maximise interoperability with the wider cultural-heritage Linked Data cloud.

terms.label: Activity
terms.definition: Direct LinkML representation of prov:Activity. Applied to events and processes that use, transform, generate, document, assess, or verify entities.

terms.label: Actor
terms.definition: General actor (person or group) responsible for events

terms.label: Age Criterion
terms.definition: Candidate must be within the prescribed pre-pubescent age range.

terms.label: Agent
terms.definition: Direct LinkML representation of prov:Agent. Agents bear responsibility for activities or entities. PROV-O permits an individual agent also to be typed as an Entity, but does not define every Agent as a subclass of Entity.

terms.label: Architectural Element
terms.definition: Carved or constructed component of an architectural structure (e.g., Gajur, Torana, Tundal)

terms.label: Architectural Structure
terms.definition: Physical structures built for religious, social, or civic purposes. Links to events of production, use, custody, and documentation.

terms.label: Architectural Style
terms.definition: A vocabulary of architectural styles for South Asian heritage, mapped to CIDOC E55 Type.

terms.label: Archival Record
terms.definition: Government or institutional administrative record

terms.label: Assertion
terms.definition: A provenance-bearing belief or claim about a heritage entity or event. The assertion is represented as CRMinf I2 Belief and as a prov:Entity, allowing source, attribution, generation time, revision, confidence, and reconciliation status to be recorded explicitly.

terms.label: Assertion Subject
terms.definition: Any HeritageGraph entity or event that may be the subject of an assertion.
restrictions: crm:E22_Human-Made_Object or heritageGraph:ArchitecturalElement or heritageGraph:Deity or heritageGraph:ReligiousTradition or heritageGraph:HistoricalEvent or heritageGraph:RitualEvent or crm:E12_Production or heritageGraph:Consecration or heritageGraph:Enshrinement or crm:E10_Transfer_of_Custody or crm:E14_Condition_Assessment or crm:E3_Condition_State or crm:E39_Actor or crm:E53_Place or crm:E52_Time-Span or heritageGraph:DataSource or heritageGraph:DocumentationActivity or heritageGraph:SyncreticRelationship or heritageGraph:KumariTenure or crm:E29_Design_or_Procedure or crm:E57_Material or heritageGraph:KumariRole or heritageGraph:SelectionCriterion or crminf:I2_Belief or heritageGraph:CalendarSystem

terms.label: Calendar System
terms.definition: Calendar reckoning system with conversion rules for multi-calendar temporal reasoning

terms.label: Caste Group
terms.definition: Hereditary social group (Jati) with specific ritual roles and occupational duties

terms.label: Chaitya
terms.definition: Buddhist votive shrine (chaitya); votive stupa form found across the Kathmandu Valley.

terms.label: Chariot Festival
terms.definition: Festival involving ceremonial chariot procession (e.g., Rato Machhindranath Jatra)

terms.label: Condition Assessment
terms.definition: Event of evaluating the physical state of a heritage object or structure

terms.label: Condition State
terms.definition: A physical condition state of a heritage object

terms.label: Condition Type
terms.definition: Controlled vocabulary for the physical condition of heritage objects and structures.

terms.label: Consecration
terms.definition: Ritual event that transforms an object into a sacred vessel (e.g., Prana Pratistha for Murti)

terms.label: Container
terms.definition: Root container for cultural heritage data instances. PLACEMENT RULE: put each instance in the most specific collection available (e.g. a Festival in festivals, not ritual_events; a Person in persons, not actors); broader collections exist for instances of the general classes only.

terms.label: Data Custodian
terms.definition: Institution or person currently responsible for stewarding heritage data.

terms.label: Data Source
terms.definition: Original source from which heritage information was derived

terms.label: Date Precision
terms.definition: Controlled vocabulary for the temporal precision of recorded heritage dates.

terms.label: Deity
terms.definition: Divine conceptual entity in Hindu, Buddhist, or syncretic traditions. Distinct from physical representations (Murti) and ritual presences.

terms.label: Destruction Event
terms.definition: Event that destroyed or damaged a structure.

terms.label: Dharmashala
terms.definition: Pilgrim lodge operated by a Guthi organization

terms.label: Dhunge Dhara
terms.definition: Stone spout (hiti) with carved imagery, used for ritual bathing and daily water supply

terms.label: Documentation Activity
terms.definition: Activity that records information about a heritage entity or event and may generate information objects or assertions. It aligns CIDOC CRM documentation practices with prov:Activity.

terms.label: Enshrinement
terms.definition: Event of installing a deity's murti or symbol within a temple sanctum

terms.label: Entity
terms.definition: Direct LinkML representation of prov:Entity. Applied to physical, digital, conceptual, and assertion-bearing things that participate in provenance relations. PROVENANCE SCOPE (design decision): for classes whose instances are real-world referents (structures, deities, places, actors), the provenance slots (was_derived_from, was_attributed_to, was_generated_by, generated_at_time) describe the DATA RECORD about the referent, not the referent itself -- a stupa is not generated by the survey that records it. Referent-level history is modelled through events (Production, DestructionEvent, etc.). RDF deployments SHOULD carry record-level provenance in named graphs or on InformationObject/Assertion nodes.

terms.label: Existence Status
terms.definition: Controlled vocabulary for whether a heritage structure still exists physically.

terms.label: Fearlessness Assessment
terms.definition: The 'fearlessness test' popularly described (animal heads, masked dancers in darkness). Its historical and contemporary practice is DISPUTED -- some former Kumaris contest how it is described. Represented as an assessment whose accounts are source-attributed via has_assertion, NOT as a mandatory criterion.

terms.label: Festival
terms.definition: Large-scale community ritual event (Jatra) involving processions, music, and collective participation

terms.label: Field Survey Activity
terms.definition: The activity of measuring, photographing, or assessing a site in person.

terms.label: Field Survey Dataset
terms.definition: The structured data or report resulting from a field survey.

terms.label: Guthi
terms.definition: Endowed trust organization unique to Nepal, managing temples, rituals, and land through hereditary or voluntary membership

terms.label: Guthi Type
terms.definition: Controlled vocabulary of Guthi functional types (CRM E55_Type)

terms.label: Historical Event
terms.definition: Major event affecting heritage structures or ritual life (earthquake, epidemic, political transition, fire, flood).

terms.label: Horoscope Compatibility Criterion
terms.definition: Candidate's horoscope must be compatible with the city and ruling authority.

terms.label: Human Made Object
terms.definition: Physical objects created by human activity

terms.label: Iconographic Object
terms.definition: Sacred visual art objects that depict or embody deities through iconographic conventions

terms.label: Information Object
terms.definition: A recorded piece of information about heritage

terms.label: Kumari Enthronement Event
terms.definition: Ritual installing a selected girl into the Kumari role and residence, activating the tenure (distinct from selection, which chooses her, and retirement, which ends it).

terms.label: Kumari House
terms.definition: God-house residence of a Kumari during tenure (e.g., Kumari Ghar, Kathmandu). Specialised ReligiousStructure.

terms.label: Kumari Lifecycle Event
terms.definition: Abstract event that bounds a KumariTenure (selection, enthronement, or retirement). Each concrete subclass requires exactly one tenure edge via slot_usage: initiated_tenure (selection), ended_tenure_of (retirement), or bounds_tenure itself (enthronement).

terms.label: Kumari Retirement Event
terms.definition: Ritual or administrative event that formally ends a Living Goddess tenure, returning the person to secular status. Common triggers: first menstruation, injury causing blood loss, serious illness.
restrictions: heritageGraph:performedByGroup only ((heritageGraph:Guthi or heritageGraph:CasteGroup) and crm:E39_Actor)

terms.label: Kumari Role
terms.definition: The role/office of Kumari (living-goddess embodiment) that a person assumes for the duration of a KumariTenure. The role is the type; the tenure is the time-bounded holding of it; the person is the holder.

terms.label: Kumari Selection Event
terms.definition: Tantric ritual process of selecting a new Living Goddess from eligible candidates. Involves examination of 32 auspicious physical marks (lakshana), horoscope matching with the city and ruling authority, and tests of fearlessness (e.g., remaining calm among buffalo heads and masked dancers in darkness). Performed by committee of Vajracharya priests, royal priest (Raj Jyotish), and astrologer.
restrictions: heritageGraph:performedByGroup only ((heritageGraph:Guthi or heritageGraph:CasteGroup) and crm:E39_Actor)

terms.label: Kumari Tenure
terms.definition: Time-bounded role where a person embodies a deity as Living Goddess (Kumari), residing at a specific god-house and supported by religious institutions. This class captures the unique Nepali tradition of living deity embodiment in young girls selected from Buddhist Shakya/Vajracharya families.

terms.label: Lineage Criterion
terms.definition: Candidate must belong to an eligible lineage (Shakya / Vajracharya Newar Buddhist family).

terms.label: Masked Dance
terms.definition: Festival featuring masked dancers embodying deities (e.g., Kartik Naach)

terms.label: Material
terms.definition: Physical substance used in construction or crafting

terms.label: Metadata
terms.definition: Dataset metadata information

terms.label: Murti
terms.definition: Consecrated statue of a deity, ritually activated to serve as divine presence (not merely depiction)

terms.label: Oral History Interview
terms.definition: The interaction event between a researcher and a knowledge holder.

terms.label: Oral History Recording
terms.definition: The recording or transcript of an oral history interview.

terms.label: Pati
terms.definition: Open-air pavilion for resting travelers

terms.label: Paubha
terms.definition: Traditional Newari scroll painting (thangka) with mandala and deity iconography

terms.label: Person
terms.definition: Individual person who performs, commissions, documents, or verifies heritage activities

terms.label: Physical Heritage Thing
terms.definition: Union of the tangible heritage classes: architectural structures, iconographic objects, and standalone architectural elements. Used as the range of slots that apply to any physical heritage thing (production, custody, condition assessment).

terms.label: Physical Integrity Criterion
terms.definition: Candidate must have an unblemished body with no scars, wounds, or loss of blood/teeth.

terms.label: Place
terms.definition: Defined geographic location where events occur and structures exist

terms.label: Pokhari
terms.definition: Pond or tank for water storage, ritual bathing, and ecological management

terms.label: Production
terms.definition: Event of creating an architectural structure, murti, or paubha

terms.label: Proposition
terms.definition: A single machine-readable proposition (subject - predicate - object) held true by an Assertion. Modelled as a singleton proposition set (CRMinf I4); the predicate is a URI/CURIE, the object either a heritage entity or a literal.

terms.label: Religious Structure
terms.definition: Architectural structure whose defining purpose is religious: enshrines a deity and/or is a locus of ritual activation. Abstract grouping for sacred structures across traditions (temple, stupa, chaitya).

terms.label: Religious Tradition
terms.definition: Religious or philosophical tradition (e.g., Hindu, Buddhist, Syncretic)

terms.label: Rest House
terms.definition: Community structures for travelers and pilgrims, maintained by Guthi organizations

terms.label: Ritual Assessment
terms.definition: A performed assessment carried out during Kumari selection. Modelled as an event (not a hard criterion) so that source-specific, possibly conflicting accounts of whether/how it was conducted attach as provenanced Assertions rather than being asserted as fact.

terms.label: Ritual Event
terms.definition: Intentional ritual activity that activates sacred space, invokes deities, and binds social groups
restrictions: heritageGraph:performedByGroup only ((heritageGraph:Guthi or heritageGraph:CasteGroup) and crm:E39_Actor)

terms.label: Ritual Type
terms.definition: Controlled vocabulary of ritual and festival activity types in Kathmandu Valley living heritage.

terms.label: Sattal
terms.definition: Multi-story rest house (3-5 floors) with ritual and social functions

terms.label: Selection Criterion
terms.definition: An eligibility criterion a candidate must satisfy to assume the Kumari role. Modelled as explicit subclasses so 'what are the eligibility criteria?' is a subclass query, not free text.

terms.label: Stupa
terms.definition: Buddhist dome-shaped reliquary shrine with circumambulation and ritual activation (e.g., Boudhanath, Swayambhunath).

terms.label: Syncretic Relationship
terms.definition: Formalizes the syncretic equivalence between divine entities across different theological frameworks. Following CIDOC CRM E13, it treats syncretism as a propositional claim with associated epistemic authority and provenance.

terms.label: Syncretic Type
terms.definition: Controlled vocabulary for kinds of syncretic theological relationships between deities.

terms.label: Technique
terms.definition: Method or craft process used in production or ritual

terms.label: Temple
terms.definition: Religious structure characterized by deity enshrinement and ritual activation. Legal designation (e.g. 'Ancient Monument' under Nepal law) is recorded per-instance via a governance assertion, not as a class criterion.

terms.label: Thirty Two Perfections Criterion
terms.definition: Candidate must exhibit the battis lakshana (thirty-two perfections/auspicious bodily marks).

terms.label: Time Span
terms.definition: Temporal extent of an event or period

terms.label: Transfer Of Custody
terms.definition: Event of transferring responsibility for temple maintenance, ritual performance, or artifact stewardship

terms.label: Verification
terms.definition: Process of cross-checking heritage claims against multiple sources

terms.label: Water Structure
terms.definition: Engineered water supply systems with ritual and civic significance

terms.label: Acted on behalf of
terms.definition: Agent on whose behalf this agent acted.

terms.label: actors
terms.definition: Collection of generic Actor instances

terms.label: Architectural elements
terms.definition: Collection of ArchitecturalElement instances

terms.label: Architectural structures
terms.definition: Heritage structures affected by or present during this historical event

terms.label: assertions
terms.definition: Collection of Assertion instances

terms.label: Asserts about
terms.definition: Heritage entity or event that is the subject of this assertion.

terms.label: Asserts proposition
terms.definition: Machine-readable proposition(s) this assertion holds to be true (CRMinf J4 that). Complements the free-text assertion_content.

terms.label: Assessed condition state
terms.definition: Condition state identified by the assessment

terms.label: Assessed object
terms.definition: Object assessed for condition

terms.label: Assesses candidate
terms.definition: Candidate being assessed.

terms.label: Assigned equivalent
terms.definition: The deity or sacred figure being identified as equivalent to the primary deity.

terms.label: Assigned to deity
terms.definition: The deity instance that is the subject of the syncretic claim.

terms.label: Assumes role
terms.definition: KumariRole held during this tenure.

terms.label: Birth timespan
terms.definition: Person's birth timespan

terms.label: Bounds tenure
terms.definition: The KumariTenure period that this lifecycle event bounds (initiates or terminates). Specialized by initiated_tenure (selection) and ended_tenure_of (retirement).

terms.label: Calendar systems
terms.definition: Collection of CalendarSystem instances

terms.label: Carried out activity
terms.definition: Activities performed by this actor

terms.label: Carried out by
terms.definition: Actor(s) who performed this event

terms.label: Caste groups
terms.definition: Collection of CasteGroup instances

terms.label: Commissioned by
terms.definition: Person or group who commissioned production

terms.label: Condition assessments
terms.definition: Collection of ConditionAssessment instances

terms.label: Condition states
terms.definition: Collection of ConditionState instances

terms.label: Confers role
terms.definition: KumariRole conferred by this selection or enthronement event.

terms.label: Consecrated by event
terms.definition: Consecration event that activated this murti

terms.label: Consecrated object
terms.definition: Murti employed in (and transformed by) the consecration ritual

terms.label: Consecration events
terms.definition: Collection of Consecration event instances

terms.label: Contains structure
terms.definition: Structures located in this place

terms.label: Custody events
terms.definition: Collection of TransferOfCustody event instances

terms.label: Data custodians
terms.definition: Collection of DataCustodian instances

terms.label: Data sources
terms.definition: Collection of DataSource instances

terms.label: Datacite creator
terms.definition: Person or organization primarily responsible for creating the source

terms.label: Datacite publisher
terms.definition: Entity responsible for making the source available

terms.label: Death timespan
terms.definition: Person's death timespan

terms.label: deities
terms.definition: Collection of Deity instances

terms.label: Depicts deity
terms.definition: Deity depicted iconographically (not cultic presence)

terms.label: Documentation activities
terms.definition: Collection of DocumentationActivity instances

terms.label: Documented in source
terms.definition: Source(s) that mention/document this entity. Distinct from was_derived_from (which is prov:wasDerivedFrom for assertions). Entity-mention is not logical derivation.

terms.label: documents
terms.definition: Pre-existing heritage entity or event recorded by this documentation activity (inverse of was_documented_by).

terms.label: Embodied deity
terms.definition: Deity role embodied by participant

terms.label: End place
terms.definition: Ending location of movement ritual

terms.label: Ended tenure of
terms.definition: Points from a KumariRetirementEvent to the tenure that it terminated. Enables reconstruction of the complete Kumari lifecycle.

terms.label: Enshrined deity
terms.definition: Deity installed through enshrinement

terms.label: Enshrined in structure
terms.definition: Temple where deity was enshrined

terms.label: Enshrinement events
terms.definition: Collection of Enshrinement event instances

terms.label: Enshrines deity through event
terms.definition: Enshrinement event that installed deity in temple

terms.label: Enthroned person
terms.definition: Girl enthroned as Kumari by this enthronement event.

terms.label: Enthroned through
terms.definition: Enthronement event that activated this tenure.

terms.label: festivals
terms.definition: Collection of Festival instances

terms.label: generated
terms.definition: Entity generated by this activity.

terms.label: guthis
terms.definition: Collection of Guthi instances

terms.label: Had participant
terms.definition: Actor(s) participating in this period, situation or ritual without carrying it out (e.g. the girl holding a Kumari tenure, or the Kumari in a chariot procession).

terms.label: Has architectural style
terms.definition: Architectural style classification

terms.label: Has assertion
terms.definition: Provenance-bearing assertion made about this entity or event.

terms.label: has calendar system
terms.definition: Calendar system used for date representation

terms.label: Has component
terms.definition: Architectural elements composing structure

terms.label: Has condition assessment
terms.definition: Condition assessment events for this structure

terms.label: Has condition type
terms.definition: Categorization of the condition state

terms.label: Has criterion
terms.definition: Eligibility criterion applied in this selection.

terms.label: Has current location
terms.definition: Current location of object or structure

terms.label: Has custody event
terms.definition: Custody transfer events for this structure

terms.label: has date precision
terms.definition: The level of precision for a recorded date.

terms.label: has destruction event
terms.definition: Event that destroyed this structure (if known)

terms.label: has existence status
terms.definition: Current physical status of the structure

terms.label: has guthi type
terms.definition: Type of Guthi (Si, Jatra, Temple)

terms.label: Has membership
terms.definition: Members of Guthi organization

terms.label: has metadata
terms.definition: Dataset metadata

terms.label: Has religious tradition
terms.definition: Religious tradition(s) within which this deity is venerated, or which use this religious structure

terms.label: has ritual type
terms.definition: Classification of ritual (puja, jatra, consecration)

terms.label: has syncretic type
terms.definition: The typological nature of the syncretism (e.g., Ontological Identity, Functional Overlap, Iconographic Similarity).

terms.label: Has timespan
terms.definition: Links event to its temporal extent

terms.label: Has type
terms.definition: Generic CRM typing property (P2 has type). Canonical holder of the CRM predicate; use the specific typing slots below in data.

terms.label: Historical events
terms.definition: Collection of HistoricalEvent (incl. DestructionEvent) instances

terms.label: Holds custody of
terms.definition: Structures under Guthi custodianship

terms.label: Human made objects
terms.definition: Collection of generic HumanMadeObject instances (use structures / iconographic_objects for subclasses)

terms.label: Hypothesized location
terms.definition: Possible locations if the structure is lost

terms.label: Iconographic objects
terms.definition: Collection of IconographicObject instances (incl. Murti, Paubha)

terms.label: Includes ritual event
terms.definition: Component rituals of festival

terms.label: Information objects
terms.definition: Collection of InformationObject instances

terms.label: Initiated tenure
terms.definition: Kumari tenure that was initiated by this selection event

terms.label: Invokes deity
terms.definition: Deity invoked or made present through ritual

terms.label: Is about
terms.definition: Heritage entity or event described by this information object.

terms.label: Is about deity
terms.definition: Deity represented and ritually associated with the Murti

terms.label: Is component of
terms.definition: Larger structure that this element is part of

terms.label: Is depicted in
terms.definition: Iconographic objects (murti, paubha) in which this deity is depicted.

terms.label: Is enshrined through event
terms.definition: Events where this deity was enshrined

terms.label: Is invoked in ritual
terms.definition: Rituals where this deity is invoked

terms.label: Is part of festival
terms.definition: Larger festival this ritual is part of

terms.label: Is primary for tradition
terms.definition: Religious tradition(s) that primarily use this calendar system (e.g., Bikram Sambat for Hindu, Nepal Sambat for Newar Buddhist)

terms.label: Kumari lifecycle events
terms.definition: Collection of Kumari lifecycle events (selection, enthronement, retirement)

terms.label: Kumari roles
terms.definition: Collection of KumariRole instances

terms.label: Kumari tenures
terms.definition: Collection of KumariTenure instances

terms.label: Makes deity present
terms.definition: Deity made present through consecration

terms.label: Managed by guthi
terms.definition: Guthi organization managing this structure or ritual

terms.label: materials
terms.definition: Collection of Material instances

terms.label: Member of group
terms.definition: Groups this person belongs to

terms.label: Occurred in presence of
terms.definition: Generic CRM presence relation (P12): entity present at an event. Canonical holder of the CRM predicate; use the specific presence slots in data.

terms.label: Occurs after
terms.definition: Points to the prerequisite ritual.

terms.label: Occurs before
terms.definition: Points to the next ritual in the canonical sequence.

terms.label: Part of selection
terms.definition: Selection event this assessment is part of.

terms.label: Participates in ritual
terms.definition: Rituals in which this structure participates

terms.label: Performed by group
terms.definition: Group (Guthi, caste) responsible for ritual

terms.label: Performs ritual
terms.definition: Rituals performed by this Guthi

terms.label: persons
terms.definition: Collection of Person instances

terms.label: Physical heritage things
terms.definition: Collection of all physical heritage objects

terms.label: places
terms.definition: Collection of Place instances

terms.label: Produced object
terms.definition: Object produced by this production event

terms.label: Production events
terms.definition: Collection of Production event instances

terms.label: Proposition object entity
terms.definition: Object of the proposition when it is a heritage entity (plays the role of rdf:object).

terms.label: Proposition subject
terms.definition: Entity the proposition is about (plays the role of rdf:subject).

terms.label: propositions
terms.definition: Collection of Proposition instances referenced by assertions

terms.label: Publication timespan
terms.definition: When source was published

terms.label: Religious traditions
terms.definition: Collection of ReligiousTradition instances

terms.label: Residence structure
terms.definition: Structure where a person resides during a specific period. For Living Goddess, this is typically a Kumari Ghar (god-house).

terms.label: Retired through
terms.definition: Retirement/desanctification event that ended this tenure.

terms.label: Ritual assessments
terms.definition: Collection of RitualAssessment (e.g. FearlessnessAssessment) instances

terms.label: Ritual events
terms.definition: Collection of RitualEvent instances

terms.label: Ritual on structure
terms.definition: Ritual occurs at specific temple or monument

terms.label: Role deity
terms.definition: Deity embodied by whoever holds this role (e.g., Taleju).

terms.label: Route places
terms.definition: Ordered list of places visited during movement ritual

terms.label: Selected person
terms.definition: Person selected through a ritual selection process to assume a sacred role or office

terms.label: Selected through
terms.definition: Selection event that initiated this tenure.

terms.label: Selection criteria
terms.definition: Collection of SelectionCriterion instances

terms.label: Start place
terms.definition: Starting location of movement ritual

terms.label: structures
terms.definition: Collection of ArchitecturalStructure instances (incl. subclasses)

terms.label: Supersedes assertion
terms.definition: Previous assertion that this one revises (version chain A1->A2->A3). Uses prov:wasRevisionOf (a derivation between entities); the latest assertion is the one with no incoming wasRevisionOf. NOTE: prov:invalidated was incorrect here (it is an Activity->Entity relation, not Entity->Entity).

terms.label: Supported by institution
terms.definition: Institution(s) providing economic support (stipend, land endowment) or ritual support (priest salaries) for a Living Goddess during tenure. Extends Guthi role beyond structure management to person support.

terms.label: Syncretic relationships
terms.definition: Collection of SyncreticRelationship instances

terms.label: techniques
terms.definition: Collection of Technique instances

terms.label: Time spans

terms.label: Took place at
terms.definition: Place where the event occurred

terms.label: Transferred from actor
terms.definition: Previous custodian

terms.label: Transferred object
terms.definition: Object transferred in custody event

terms.label: Transferred to actor
terms.definition: New custodian (person or group)

terms.label: Transferred to guthi
terms.definition: New custodian (Guthi)

terms.label: used
terms.definition: Entity used by this activity.

terms.label: Used by
terms.definition: Actor(s) who use, handle, or are responsible for this object in ritual contexts

terms.label: Used materials

terms.label: Used technique
terms.definition: Craft technique used in production

terms.label: Verified assertion

terms.label: Verified by expert

terms.label: Was associated with
terms.definition: Agent associated with responsibility for this activity.

terms.label: Was attributed to
terms.definition: Agent to whom responsibility for this entity is attributed.

terms.label: Was derived from

terms.label: Was documented by
terms.definition: Documentation event that recorded this (pre-existing) entity or event. Uses heritageGraph:documentedBy (aligned to prov:wasInfluencedBy). NOTE: prov:wasGeneratedBy was incorrect: a stupa is not *generated by* the survey that records it.

terms.label: Was generated by
terms.definition: Activity that generated this entity.

terms.label: Was influenced by
terms.definition: General PROV-O influence relation. Prefer a more specific PROV relation whenever one applies.

terms.label: Was informed by
terms.definition: Activity that informed this activity; PROV-O uses this when the intervening generated and used entity is unknown or omitted.

terms.label: Was present at
terms.definition: Generic CRM presence relation (P12i): event this entity was present at. Canonical holder of the CRM predicate; use the specific slots in data.

terms.label: Was produced by event
terms.definition: Event that created this object or structure

terms.label: Assertion content
terms.definition: The factual claim being asserted

terms.label: Confidence score

terms.label: Custodian type
terms.definition: Type of custodian (government, academic, community), free text

terms.label: Data quality note
terms.definition: Notes on data quality, completeness, or uncertainty

terms.label: Datacite identifier
terms.definition: Persistent identifier for the source (DOI, archive ID, catalog number)

terms.label: Datacite identifier type
terms.definition: Type of identifier (DOI, ISBN, Handle, LocalArchiveID)

terms.label: Datacite resource type
terms.definition: High-level DataCite resource type (Dataset, Text, Image, Audio, Interview)

terms.label: Dataset name
terms.definition: Human-readable name of the dataset.

terms.label: Dataset version
terms.definition: Version identifier of the dataset instance.

terms.label: Date earliest

terms.label: Date latest
terms.definition: Latest possible date (for uncertain dates)
